Weekday a few tips for regular visitors
With that in mind
Companion Animal Travel Desk notice

Travelers should know that our desk reviews each pet trip with care so the journey stays calm and safe. The team checks common risks, keeps paperwork in order, and helps make sure every companion is matched to the right travel plan.

When a pet is moved between services, the ground team handles carriers gently and watches for signs of stress. Care plans are adjusted for species, temperament, and comfort, since a quiet cat, an active dog, and a more nervous animal may all need different support. Small details matter, from secure latches to steady handling, and the goal is always to reduce worry for both travelers and pets.

If you are preparing to fly with Aurelia Skyways, please bring any required pet items in good condition and tell the Companion Animal Travel Desk about anything unusual before check-in. Simple updates help the team plan ahead and keep the process smooth.

Please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk before you head to the gate.
